definitions.explanation: Having been mentioned earlier in the same text or talk. A formal written word with the same meaning as the commoner {前述|ぜんじゅつ}.

examples.japanese: {先述|せんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおりです。
{先述|せんじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please try the method described earlier.

examples.japanese: {先述|せんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧わかる。
examples.english: From the survey results mentioned earlier, we can see that most users are young people.

notes:
Made of {先|せん} (before) + {述|じゅつ} (state). It means the same as ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧, which is far more common; {先述|せんじゅつ} appears mainly in reports, papers and official documents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先述|せんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the ~ mentioned earlier
- {先述|せんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり／よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as stated earlier
- {先述|せんじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜: the ~ described earlier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧: mentioned above (the usual word)
- ⟦{後述|こうじゅつ}→後述：32690_koujutsu⟧: mentioned later, described below
- ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧: the above (in a document or form)
